ns2:course.label: Evolutionary Survey of Plants
ns2:course.description: (IB 369) Lecture and laboratory course dealing with the structure, reproduction, and evolutionary origins of land plants as represented by living mosses, liverworts, ferns, lycopods, horsetails, conifers, cycads and flowering plants. Prerequisite: IB 102 or IB 103 or IB 150; IB 201 recommended; or consent of instructor.
